title: Aerial Gas Tomography — Data and Analysis
description:
Field data and analysis code for aerial gas tomography: the reconstruction of two-dimensional methane (CH4) distributions from remote TDLAS measurements taken by a drone with a gimballed laser sensor. The dataset contains the raw data of the experiments carried out at the Bundesanstalt für Materialforschung und -prüfung (BAM) in 2016–2020 (earth-wall and aiming experiments 2016, 2D plume 2017, static CH4 bag and drone-to-drone measurements 2020, and unpublished, unevaluated free-plume and two-slice experiments of July 2020), the original analysis code (Python, Matlab) and a reproduction of the central results of four publications (IEEE SENSORS 2018, European Journal of Remote Sensing 2019, IEEE ISOEN 2022, IEEE ISOEN 2024), including all checks and the differences found.

Raw data are losslessly compressed; SHA-256 checksums of the original files are included. One command (reproduce.py or the notebook reproduce.ipynb) recreates all results.
notes: Data, results and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Code (analysis/, reproduce.py, reproduce.ipynb, tests/): MIT licence (see LICENSE). This dataset documents preliminary work for the proposal CACTUS (DFG Priority Programme SPP 2433); it was produced before and independently of CACTUS and contains no results of the CACTUS project.
